# Traffic Management System — Copilot Instructions

- Keep the UI focused on traffic operations in metropolitan Melbourne.
- Treat impact outputs as indicative scenario comparisons, never as validated forecasts or safety advice.
- Keep frontend models aligned with the FastAPI Pydantic schemas.
- Use GeoJSON coordinates in longitude, latitude order (EPSG:4326).
- Keep sample data clearly identifiable and avoid storing secrets in source control.
- Validate user inputs and preserve accessible labels and keyboard interactions.
